name: Aune Audio
_the_lot_first_cited_a_brand_id_that_DOE: The records under this brand were first written citing a short brand id - « aune » and « yulong » - while this file's id is the long form. The helper ecrire_lot.fiche_marque() REFUSED to create a second brand file and named this one instead, which is exactly what it was written for: three times on 2026-11-25 a script that could not find a brand file at the name it guessed went on to CREATE one, producing the Cambridge Audio, Cyrus and MUSICIAN duplicates. Here the refusal came before any file was written, the device identities were corrected to this id, and no duplicate exists. The verifier's own « brand is not in database/brands » error caught the device side a moment later - two independent guards, one on the write and one on the read.
_terms_an_APP_agreement_not_a_website_on: Measured 2026-11-25 and the scope is the whole question. en.auneaudio.com, where the products and manuals live, publishes NO terms page: the footer has no legal link and /terms, /privacy, /legal, /about and their /page/ variants all 404. Footer: « (c) 2026 Aune Audio. All rights reserved. » www.auneaudio.com, the maker's Chinese single-page site on the same registrable domain, DOES carry a reuse clause at /service.html: « You may not reproduce, modify, distribute, or otherwise use these contents without our explicit written permission. » But its preamble scopes it - « Welcome to the Aune Control App [...] This service agreement [...] regarding the use of the App » - and the clause's own subject is « The App and all its content ». The privacy page is App-scoped too. So the clause governs an application and the product pages sit on a host that publishes nothing. Records were written on that reading; the stricter view - same company, same registrable domain, therefore site-wide - is tenable, and the clause is quoted on every record so it can be taken. The Shanling shape inverted: there a STORE's prose did not reach the product host, here an APP's does not.
_a_distributor_that_is_not_the_maker: aune-store.com is a different registrable domain whose own Impressum names a third party - « Florian Mich M.A. Anichstraße 2a 6020 Innsbruck Österreich » - and which calls itself « Offizieller Shop von Aune Audio Deutschland & Österreich ». A distributor, not the maker; its terms were not read and no record cites it. mall.auneaudio.com, the maker's own « Official Store » link, returns 403.
_robots_txt_with_an_unedited_TEMPLATE_de: en.auneaudio.com/robots.txt is « User-Agent: * / Allow: / » with /Manage and /Auth disallowed, no Content-Signal and no Claude group - and its sitemap line reads « Sitemap: https://example.com/sitemap.xml », an unedited template default, with /sitemap.xml itself listing six example.com URLs. www.auneaudio.com serves no robots.txt at all; api.en.auneaudio.com returns 401.
_every_product_page_is_images_and_the_ma: Checked on nine product pages: each `specs_html` field contains nothing but img tags. Every figure under this brand comes from the manual PDFs at en.auneaudio.com/downloads - and those PDFs lose most inter-word SPACES in extraction, « upto32bit/768k », so quotes are kept exactly as extracted. Fourth brand this week behind an image wall with a door, after Shanling, xDuoo and Sabaj.
_four_maker_hosted_PDFs_are_BROKEN: All four return HTTP 500 from api.en.auneaudio.com: the three « USB Connection & DSD Settings » files - one linked from the X8 XVIII's own product page - and the « S10N/Pro Bluetooth/Streaming Guide ». The X8 XVIII's native-versus-DoP question most likely lives in one of them, which is why that record states neither.
_models_the_brief_named_that_the_maker_d: S6 Pro and S8 are NOT on the maker's site: the full 44-item catalogue contains neither, /product/S8 and /product/S6Pro return 404, and no manual exists for either. The AK4497 and ES9038PRO attributions that circulate for them come from retailers and reviews, so they are absent FROM THE MAKER rather than quotable from anyone else. « Flamingo » is not an Aune product on this site either - not in the catalogue, and /product/Flamingo 404s.
_no_NOS_and_no_bypass_anywhere_in_the_ra: The word NOS appears on no Aune page and in no Aune manual read, so the non-oversampling against New-Old-Stock ambiguity never arose, and no model is described as having a valve output stage. No model claims an oversampling bypass or a filter-OFF position: every menu is a choice AMONG filters, so `correctable` is written on no Aune record. And no model in the current range states an I2S audio INPUT - the only I2S socket found, on the S10N/S10 Pro, is an output marked « for local playback only ».
